messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

Since v_initial=0, distance = 0.5 * a * t^2 => a = 2*distance / t^2. Then final speed after first part: v_final = v_initial + a*t = a*t. So we can compute a and v_final.

Then second part: car continues accelerating for 5 s, starting from speed 12 m/s? Wait: "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" Means starting at 12 m/s accelerate to final speed which is twice the initial speed? But initial speed refers to what? It says "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍". So final speed after second stage is twice the speed computed in first part. So initial speed for second stage is 12 m/s? But then they say final speed is twice the speed from first part. That would be inconsistent unless the speed from first part is 12 m/s. Let's check: If first part final speed is 12 m/s, then second part initial speed is 12 m/s, final speed is twice that, i.e., 24 m/s. That matches both statements. So likely first part final speed is 12 m/s. Let's compute: distance 120 m, time 10 s, starting from rest. Using average speed formula: average speed = distance/time = 12 m/s. Starting from rest with constant acceleration, average speed = (v_initial + v_final)/2 = v_final/2. So v_final = 2*average speed = 24 m/s. Wait that gives 24 m/s. But earlier we thought 12 m/s.
